scope: the skill-application receipt capstone: check-skill-receipt.mjs gate + skill-receipt.config.json coupling map + docs/skill-receipts/{log.jsonl,README.md} (dogfooded receipt + banner) + test/skill-receipt.test.mjs + the @security feature + docs/specs/skill-application-receipt.md + ADR-0038 + wiring (always-on directive, CONTRIBUTING, PR template, README, package.json)

boundary.evidence: the validator lives with the other repo-health gates (judge-arch/scripts); the log is a doc artifact, the coupling map a config. Logic is not in a skill body.

ownership.evidence: the receipt log is the single owner of what-was-applied; the config is the single owner of the coupling map; the skill set is derived from the filesystem.

dependency.evidence: dependency-free, offline; no web, db, request, or session; reuses the routing env-safe changed-list pattern.

error-handling.evidence: FOUND + FIXED (HIGH): quote-match was file-wide, so a quote from the frontmatter or an unrelated section grounded nothing (the dogfood judge-arch quote was 94 lines from its anchor). Now scoped to the cited heading section (frontmatter never included). FOUND + FIXED (LOW): lexical traversal check did not follow symlinks; added realpathSync canonical containment. Fail-closed paths otherwise correct (verified: banner-missing, all-anchors-missing, malformed input all die closed).

ownership.evidence: single owner of per-change application claims.

error-handling.evidence: FOUND + FIXED: the dogfood quotes cited real headings but quoted text from other sections (the symptom of the HIGH finding). Re-derived every applied quote to be a verbatim run under its cited H2 heading; validates against the real skills.

FOUND + FIXED (MED): the directive, README, CONTRIBUTING, and PR template implied the bare `npm run check:receipt` checks diff binding, coupling, and append-only; it does not (they need the diff/base). Reworded all four to state exactly what the bare command checks vs what needs --changed-list/--base, and that the merge-blocking CI job is deferred to the techfleetnetwork release; fixed the inaccurate test comment.

20 discriminating cases incl. the new frontmatter-quote and wrong-section-quote fails and the symlink-escape fail (skips where the OS forbids symlinks); real-repo case keeps the committed receipt honest.

findings.title: quote-match was file-wide, not bound to the cited heading; a frontmatter or wrong-section quote grounded nothing
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: the dogfood judge-arch quote (line 8) was 94 lines above its cited heading (line 102) and passed. Fixed: quotes now match only within the cited heading section (heading to next equal-or-higher heading), frontmatter excluded; 2 discriminating tests; dogfood re-aligned.

findings.title: docs said the bare check:receipt proves full grounding, but diff binding, coupling, and append-only are not checked by it or any CI job
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: bare run discloses NOT checked for diff binding/coupling/append-only. Reworded directive/README/CONTRIBUTING/PR-template to be exact and to name the deferred CI job; fixed the inaccurate test comment. CI job stays deferred per the no-new-CI decision.

findings.title: path-traversal defense was lexical only; a committed symlink inside the skills dir would escape it
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: added realpathSync canonical containment on the skills dir and each anchor file; symlink-escape test (skips on platforms that forbid unprivileged symlinks).

findings.title: humanReviewed is presence-only and null passes; the mandatory human review is process-enforced, not gated
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: by design and the stated irreducible limit, worded consistently across the gate output, banner, spec, and ADR; no change.

grepCommands: npm test -> 412 tests, 410 pass, 0 fail, 2 skip (symlink skip on Windows + conditional) (observed)
node check-skill-receipt.mjs (bare) -> exit 0; with --changed-list -> exit 0 (diff binding + coupling pass for this change) (observed)
npm run check:architecture -> exit 0; check:links -> PASS; check:routing -> PASS 1 rule fired (new-gate-needs-test) (observed)
fresh-context review found 3 findings (HIGH quote-not-section-bound, MED docs-overclaim, LOW symlink) all fixed at root cause with discriminating tests; INFO humanReviewed by-design (observed)
verdict: PASS after fixes; review caught a HIGH false-negative (file-wide quote), a MED overclaim, and a LOW symlink gap, all resolved structurally; the dogfood receipt was re-grounded to its cited sections
